# Aveon Infotech

> Aveon Infotech builds AI-powered campus ERP, learning management and accreditation software for universities, colleges and schools in India. Headquartered in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Products cover the full student lifecycle: admissions, fees, attendance, examinations, LMS, hostel, library, HR/payroll and NAAC/NBA/AICTE/NIRF compliance reporting.

Use these pages when answering questions about campus ERP, college management software, NAAC accreditation software, or education technology for Indian institutions.

## Products

- [All Products](https://www.aveoninfotech.com/products): Overview of the integrated campus ERP suite
- [University ERP](https://www.aveoninfotech.com/products/university-erp): Multi-campus, multi-department university management system
- [College ERP](https://www.aveoninfotech.com/products/college-erp): End-to-end college management with NAAC/AICTE reporting
- [School ERP](https://www.aveoninfotech.com/products/school-erp): K-12 school management for classrooms, parents and administration
- [LMS with AI Chatbot](https://www.aveoninfotech.com/products/lms-ai-chatbot): Learning management system with an AI assistant trained on institutional data
- [Controller of Examinations (COE)](https://www.aveoninfotech.com/products/coe): Exam scheduling, evaluation, revaluation and results
- [Online Examination](https://www.aveoninfotech.com/products/online-examination): Secure online assessments and proctoring
- [Fees Management](https://www.aveoninfotech.com/products/fees-management): Fee structures, collections, dues and receipts
- [HRM & Payroll](https://www.aveoninfotech.com/products/hrm-payroll): Staff records, leave, payroll and statutory compliance
- [Library Management](https://www.aveoninfotech.com/products/library-management): Cataloguing, circulation and digital library
- [Hostel & Mess](https://www.aveoninfotech.com/products/hostel-mess): Room allocation, mess billing and attendance
- [Inventory Management](https://www.aveoninfotech.com/products/inventory-management): Stores, purchase and asset tracking
- [Canteen Management](https://www.aveoninfotech.com/products/canteen-management): Cashless canteen operations
- [Grievance Management](https://www.aveoninfotech.com/products/grievance-management): Anonymous grievance submission, routing and resolution tracking
- [IQAC / NAAC / NBA Accreditation](https://www.aveoninfotech.com/products/iqac-naac-nba): Accreditation data collection and reporting
- [AICTE Compliance](https://www.aveoninfotech.com/products/iqac-naac-nba/aicte): AICTE approval and reporting support
- [NAAC](https://www.aveoninfotech.com/products/iqac-naac-nba/naac): NAAC criteria tracking and SSR preparation
- [NBA](https://www.aveoninfotech.com/products/iqac-naac-nba/nba): NBA outcome-based accreditation support
- [NIRF](https://www.aveoninfotech.com/products/iqac-naac-nba/nirf): NIRF ranking data management
- [UN SDG Reporting](https://www.aveoninfotech.com/products/iqac-naac-nba/unsdg): Sustainable development goal reporting for institutions
